title: 51happily
description: On May 1st, each player receives a “Happy Labor Day” chat message upon every login. Supports 10 languages via resource pack.
body:
A lightweight datapack that welcomes players on Labor Day.

· Trigger: Player logs in on May 1st (real date via TimeLib).
· Effect: Sends a colorful greeting in the player’s language.
· Repeat: Triggers on every login during May 1st (resets each year).
· Audio: Plays a gentle pickup sound.
· Dependencies: TimeLib – timezone must be set.

No extra commands needed – just install, reload, and enjoy the holiday wishes.

---
一个轻量级数据包，在劳动节向玩家送上问候。

· 触发条件：玩家在5月1日登录游戏（通过TimeLib获取真实日期）。
· 效果：以玩家语言显示彩色祝福消息。
· 重复触发：5月1日当天每次登录都会触发（每年重置）。
· 音效：播放轻柔的经验球拾取音效。
· 依赖项：TimeLib – 需配置时区。

无需额外指令，安装并重载后即可享受节日祝福。
